description: Cars Phase 1 HPO using only the cosine affinity from Iscen label propagation: positive-part cosine similarity raised to gamma, with W + W.T symmetrization. Fix edge_weighting to cosine while HPO tunes gamma from 1 to 10, matching the existing Iscen search range. All other parameters follow the Cars Phase 1 LRML HPO recipe. LRML remains uncapped (regularizer_max_ratio = null).
name: lrml_iscen_weighting
